name: Vector synthesis: XY-blend four oscillators with nested crossfades
goal: Build classic vector synthesis portably: place four distinct oscillator shapes at the corners of an XY pad (bipolar −1…+1), nest three crossfade/blend stages driven by the X and Y axes so each corner is soloable and the center mixes all four, then add an amp envelope — a 2D morph that is not a 1D wavetable scan.

source.title: Vector Synthesis in Bitwig Grid with the Scrawl Oscillator

prerequisites: Four oscillators or drawable single-cycle shapes
An XY / vector control (or two bipolar modulators for X and Y)
Crossfade/blend modules (or equal-power pan laws) that mix two inputs by a 0…1 or −1…+1 control

inputs.name: corner_waves
inputs.description: Four original/free shapes (e.g. sine, saw, complex drawable, noisy/odd) assigned to NW/NE/SW/SE

inputs.name: xy
inputs.description: Bipolar XY position; automate or LFO later for motion

outputs.name: vector_osc_bus
outputs.description: Single mixed oscillator bus whose timbre is the XY blend of four corners

constraints: Portable module recipe; not affiliated with Bitwig. Use original/free waveforms — do not copy proprietary Scrawl factory drawings as content.
Vector ≠ wavetable: WT scans one dimension; vector lets you move between corners and through the interior mix.

steps.action: Instantiate four oscillators. Load contrasting shapes into the four corners (e.g. sine, saw, a complex drawable, an odd/noisy shape). Keep pitches unified unless you intentionally detune later.
steps.expect: Each corner alone is a clear, different timbre

steps.action: Add an XY control set to bipolar mode so (0,0) is the center and each axis runs −1…+1 (unipolar XY only covers one quadrant and cannot reach all four corners).
steps.expect: Center is neutral; each corner of the pad is reachable

steps.action: First vertical blends: mix top-left with bottom-left using the Y axis (positive Y favors the upper osc, negative the lower). Separately mix top-right with bottom-right with the same Y.
steps.expect: Moving only on Y morphs within the left column and within the right column

steps.action: Horizontal master blend: mix the left-column result with the right-column result using the X axis (wire X at full bipolar depth, e.g. ±50% into the blend if your modulator is bipolar).
steps.expect: Park the XY in each corner and confirm only that corner oscillator is audible (scope helps)

steps.action: Verify interior points: center should combine all four; edges should be two-osc mixes. Contrast with a 1D wavetable scan that cannot jump sideways between non-adjacent frames.
steps.expect: 2D motion yields combinations a linear WT position cannot

steps.action: Finish with an ADSR (or similar) on the blended output level. Optionally LFO/automate X and Y slowly for evolving pads; keep mono compatibility in mind if later widening.
steps.expect: Playable vector voice with a clean amp envelope

verification: Each of the four XY corners solos its assigned oscillator.
Center mix is a blend of all four, not silence or a single osc.
Moving diagonally changes timbre continuously without zipper from discontinuous WT frame jumps.
